wave.title: sln: Asterisk raw signed 16-bit PCM demuxer
wave.scope: Demux-only, not headerless: `-f sln` or an undeclared input whose path ends in `.sln` (demux.extensions ['.sln']; native has no read_probe and scores the extension 50). Fixed native defaults pcm_s16le, 8000 Hz, mono (sln_options sample_rate=8000, ch_layout=mono); open returns openRawPcm over the whole input. Default packet span pcmPacketSpan(8000)=512 (probe: 512-sample rows). Refused: input -ar/-ac (the PCM path already refuses them for non-headerless formats; native honours them, probe -ar 16000 gives 1024-sample packets), the -sample_rate/-ch_layout demuxer options (CLI refuses), a trailing partial sample, input -ss>0 until probed. No muxer exists natively.

wave.title: sol: Sierra SOL PCM demuxer (DPCM refused)
wave.scope: Demux-only. Probe: low 16 bits of RL32 are 0x0B8D/0x0C0D/0x0C8D and bytes 2-5 are "SOL\0" (head 4 bytes, confirm 6 bytes, precedence 100). Header: magic u16, tag, rate u16le, type u8, size u32 (ignored), plus one padding byte unless magic 0x0B8D (data at 13 or 14). Codec per sol_codec_id: type&1 -> sol_dpcm (refused); magic 0x0B8D -> pcm_u8 mono; type&4 -> pcm_s16le; else pcm_u8; stereo when type&16 and magic != 0x0B8D, av_channel_layout_default. Packets are 4096 bytes, so packetSpan = 4096/blockAlign (probe: 1024 for s16 stereo, 4096 for old u8); the CORRUPT flag is cleared, so short final packets are exact. Refused: DPCM, rate 0, trailing partial sample, input -ss>0 until probed. Data runs to EOF.

waveRules: Every branch is named wave2/<slug>, holds one capability item, contains no merges from other branches, and is squashed to one commit ending with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Batch 1 is cut from 22fcb7a; batches 2-4 are cut from the wave2/prep head.

A branch may touch only its ownedFiles plus its declared registry lines. The coordinator checks `git diff --name-only <base>...wave2/<slug>` against that list and sends back any branch with extra paths.

Each branch contains: the module(s); its registry line(s); tests/unit/<...>.test.ts; tests/differential/<...>.test.ts, which generates its inputs and runs native at test time, with no committed native goldens; docs/contributing/<...>.md (syntax, supported vs refused forms, determinism and arithmetic profile, evidence counts, proposed contracts with exact file, title, scope and platforms, and the sandbox's ffmpeg sha256 and `cc --version`); NOTICE-<NAME> citing commit 946fcce0; and the report docs/contributing/wave2/<slug>.json.

Native at test time: read .build/reference/build-metadata.json and assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm. Never pin a binary sha and never compare with committed digests. Do not use pinnedReference(), referenceNumericProfile() or the native-corpus helpers: they require the pinned linux-x64 binary, which a sandbox build need not reproduce. Bootstrap with `npm run bootstrap -- --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference`.

Platform gating: integer and copy cases run everywhere. Float-sensitive cases run only on linux-x64, in tests with a constant title whose contract declares "platforms": ["linux-x64"], and are skipped elsewhere with it.skipIf. Never drop cases inside a passing test per platform (dcshift/aderivative). A gate without a measured macOS difference is recorded as a precaution.
Refusal statuses tied to errno use the host value from os.constants.errno for native and the Linux value for EdgeFFmpeg (ircam, wave 1).

Before pushing, run the branch's unit and differential files (differential with --maxWorkers=1), the registry tests of its area (tests/unit/audio-filter-registry.test.ts and audio-filter-registry-extension.test.ts; tests/unit/video-operator-registry.test.ts; tests/unit/container-registry*.test.ts), then npm run typecheck, lint and boundaries. Do not run the full `npm test` or `npm run check`: they need edge-flac.wasm. Each differential file should finish in about 3 minutes on 4 vCPUs.
Sandbox: Node 24 or later. Per-test mkdtemp directories, never a shared scratch path.

Audio: keep rateConversion, timeSelection and formatConstraint false. Never use output -ar/-ac; declare rate and channels on raw input only. Use -cpuflags 0 whenever float is converted to integer. No commas inside filter arguments. Refuse in constraint() any input that native would resample or remix (apulsator and stereotools: mono input is remixed natively; probed). Declare every ring or history in reserve(). Frame-grouping evidence uses asetnsamples=n=N:p=0, because the default pads the final frame. No FLAC integration or workers tests.

Video: refuse enable= and runtime commands. Flag all five paths (four for joins) only when the actor and timed differential tests pass; otherwise flag fewer and add rejection tests. Put size-dependent refusals in geometry() and repeat them in frame(). Feed inputs in the operator's own formats, and run any implicit conversion with -cpuflags 0. Use structured patterns as well as noise. Never mirror native reads of uninitialised or out-of-bounds memory; refuse those cases.

Video test conventions used in the scopes: [T-FRAME] rawvideo inputs in each executable format of the native list, sizes 1x1, 2x2, 5x3, 7x5, 8x6 and 17x9, noise plus ramps, edges and constant planes, 3 frames, rawvideo and framecrc outputs with and without -ss/-t. [T-JOIN] the same with N distinct inputs of equal size and format and split-from-one-source graphs, equal rates and unequal lengths, mismatches refused with native's status. [P5] linear, graph, stream (createReplayVideoExecution), actor and timed paths; [PJ] graph, stream, actor and timed. [NEG] the per-source negotiation test on tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts. [UNIT] parse and every refusal, maxFrameBytes, malformed strides, AbortSignal, input not mutated, owned output planes. [THREADS] native with default threads and with -filter_threads 1 must agree. [JOIN-SYNC] vf_stack sync semantics: every input sync=1, before=EXT_STOP, after=EXT_INFINITY (EXT_STOP under shortest). [FS-OPTS] accept shortest; refuse eof_action other than repeat, repeatlast=0 and non-default ts_sync_mode.

Containers: validate output before creating it. Refuse inputs whose native demuxer exports metadata that the chosen muxer would write (set info.metadata). Refuse partial trailing frames and platform-dependent float-to-integer paths. Keep codec, tag and chunk tables private to the module.

Merging: merge in ascending order, locally with git (hosted merge buttons may ignore merge=union). After each union merge, check the three registry files for duplicated lines (wave 1 needed 4bd37b1 for two). `git revert` also applies merge=union, so remove a reverted branch's registry lines by hand (2934bb9). A conflict in any other file means the branch broke ownership: reject it, do not hand-merge. In local worktrees, replace the upstream/ffmpeg symlink with an empty directory for merge and revert, and never stage upstream/ffmpeg.

Validation: after each batch is merged, run typecheck and the registry unit tests, then push linux-probe/wave2-batch-<n> with .github/linux-probe.json listing that batch's unit and differential files, so the linux-gated cases run on real x86_64 in the pinned image.
